codelines.evidence: Opened src/services/contentstack.ts — the central Contentstack SDK initialization file. It calls contentstack.Stack(options) at line 91 with a config object (api_key, delivery_token, environment, branch, fetchOptions) but contains NO live_preview config block (no preview_token, no live_preview key, no host for rest-preview.contentstack.com). A second Stack instance is created at line 409 for Interactive Maps, also without live_preview. Searched the entire src/ tree for 'live_preview', 'preview_token', 'onEntryChange', and 'live-preview-utils' — zero matches, confirming no existing Live Preview infrastructure. The package manifest declares @contentstack/utils and contentstack but NOT @contentstack/live-preview-utils, which the ticket's linked docs require installing. CodeGraph explore surfaced useContent (src/hooks/useContent.ts) as the primary client-side data hook consumed by ~40+ components (ContentstackText, ContentstackLink, ContentstackQuote, ContentstackGallery, etc.), which is where onEntryChange wiring would need to be integrated per the CSR Live Preview documentation. The data-fetching pattern is server-side (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getSingletonEntry) with client-side consumption via useContent/getContentByKey, meaning Live Preview would require both SDK config changes in contentstack.ts and client-side onEntryChange listener wiring in or around useContent.

recommendedInvestigators.focus: Wire Contentstack Live Preview into the existing SDK initialization and client-side data hooks. Specifically: (1) Add live_preview config (preview_token, enable, host) to the contentstack.Stack(options) call in src/services/contentstack.ts; (2) Install and initialize @contentstack/live-preview-utils in a separate utility file, configuring stackSdk, ssr:false, editButton, stackDetails; (3) Wire onEntryChange into the useContent hook (src/hooks/useContent.ts) so client-side components re-fetch CMS data on entry changes; (4) Determine whether a preview token env var already exists or needs creation; (5) Consider whether protected pages and auth-gated routes (next-auth is a dependency) need exclusion from Live Preview per the ticket's noted limitation.
recommendedInvestigators.why: The codeline has a mature Contentstack integration (Stack initialization, ContentstackFactory, getEntry/getSingleEntry/getSingletonEntry, 40+ consuming components via useContent) but zero existing Live Preview infrastructure — no live_preview config, no @contentstack/live-preview-utils dependency, no onEntryChange listener. The ticket's linked docs map directly onto this codeline's architecture: CSR Next.js app with contentstack SDK and @contentstack/utils already present.
